title: preview stage-preview job payload

pipelineVersionId.description: The saved draft version (template parameters) or the version a new source's form would use.

collectionId.description: The collection the source is in or would be in: its publicity decides the personal-data state shown (processing design §9.5).

sourceId.description: Absent for a new source's form; required with uploadIds.

urls.description: URLs fetched live through the egress guard and host politeness, for a source without documents.

untilStage.description: The last stage to run; index never runs.

basePreviewJobId.description: A preview of the same documents whose outputs (previews/{basePreviewJobId}/) are reused up to the first stage whose settings changed.

embed.description: Embed through the gateway; without it the embed stage reports chunk count and tokens only.

piiSpans.description: Write the personal-data spans, for the PII highlights (admin design §4.7).

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of a preview job of kind stage-preview (engine design §11): up to five documents (documentIds, urls or uploadIds) through the pipeline version up to untilStage, writing only previews/{jobId}/. No dedup, except pii-preview:{documentId} for the PII highlights of one document.
